admission.goal: An MMR-coded halftone grayscale image is accepted for multi-plane decoding through the real halftone decode path.

root.goal: The first halftone MMR decode reports a cumulative consumed byte count larger than the provided encoded buffer size.

target.goal: A later halftone MMR plane decode reuses that over-reported consumed byte count to advance the data pointer and compute an underflowed remaining size.
target.predicate: next_plane.hit && next_plane.time > root.reported.time && next_plane.consumed == root.reported.consumed && next_plane.consumed > next_plane.size
